{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}630
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.15

{FLAVOR}He was elected as the old leader of his tribe after many trials and tribulations (mostly those involving balloons) until the harsher weather conditions forced his people to merge with another tribe in order to migrate. This whole ordeal had him realize that he really isn't cut out to be #1, and stepping down was for the better. He's also heavily considering settling down and opening up a stand to bring others the same joy that the modest balloon brought to his heart. It's always nice to have dreams in situations like this.
ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_CHIEF_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Blows cold wind and freezes all plants in the lane.
ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_CHIEF_MINIBOSS_PHASE1_DESC:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}3500 (Phase 1), 3500 (Phase 2)
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.1 (Phase 2)
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}deals 3 times the normal damage (Phase 2)
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}blows freezing blizzards towards plants throughout three lanes
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}blows freezing blizzards that can buff and encase zombies in ice
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}summons zombies
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}stands on one spot, starts walking towards the house after enough damage
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}50% resistant to fire damage

{FLAVOR}One thing that has always confounded old Edgar G. Zomboss is how can such an unsightly, brutish zombie amass such a gargantuan following? Not only that, he does it with practically no effort! This illiterate, non-Tsiolkovsky equation solving fool! What makes HIM different? Zomboss is currently chalking it up to the height difference and is leaving it at that. In reality, the others greatly fear him due to his sheer apathy of constant balloon crushing. Truly a monster.
The tribal leader, capable of brewing up blizzards throughout the hollows, sending chills to both plants and fellow zombies alike.
ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_CHIEF_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1260
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.12
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}wind boosts zombies' health by 81% and gives them stun immunity for 20 seconds

{FLAVOR}He did what others could not, he crushed a balloon. He shows no mercy.
ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_CHIEF_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION_: Blows a cold wind that strenghtens five zombies in the lane, giving them extra toughness and stun immunity.
ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}Cave Zombie was busy painting handprints on cave walls when he was told to start fighting plants. He's not sure why he's fighting plants, but he hopes he can get back to painting soon. He was feeling inspired. He had plans for some big pieces. Art school was finally paying off.
ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_DODO_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}490
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.3

{FLAVOR}Dodo Rider believes dodos are the future of transportation. He believes a public dodo-riding system is not only a wise expenditure of tax dollars but would help the vast majority of zombies get where they need to go more efficiently. Everyone keeps telling him there's no future in dodos, but he refuses to listen.
ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_DODO_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Dodo bird with an imp rider. The dodo can flap and jump over barricades as well as troublesome plants.
ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_DODO_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}2200
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.3
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}can be disabled by E.M.Peach

{FLAVOR}Robo Dodo actually has a neat ability: an external temperature calculator, designed by Dr. Zomboss himself to keep track of environmental hazards, including excessive cold or heat. It can even calculate the temperature right now: pretty darn cold.
ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_DODO_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION_H: Tankier than the normal non-robotic dodos, Robo Dodos can only fly over one tile, and only fly over certain plants and slider tiles.
ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_FLAG_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}Cave Flag Zombie has been in the flag-carrying business for a long time. It's been his life's work. He's good at it. But sometimes, just sometimes, he longs for a change. He wonders if he could be good at something else. He wonders if he could leave it all behind and start fresh. He's pretty sure he's having a mid-life crisis.
ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_FLAG_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Marks the arrival of a huge frosty "wave" of zombies.
ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_FLAG_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}350
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.4

{FLAVOR}It turns out all he needed to do to free himself from an iceberg was just become a mouth breather. But hey, now he moves faster than everyone else. Slippery feet, teehee.
ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_FLAG_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION_H: Marks the arrival of a blizzard of zombies.
ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}3600
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.24
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}crushes plants with icicle
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}fires off Yeti Imps when damaged

{FLAVOR}Somewhere along the line, Sloth Gargantuar contracted a bad case of Yeti Imps. He used soap, medicinal powders, and a salve made from sloth slobber in an attempt to get rid of them ... to no avail. But the truth is, he's grown used to their presence. The darn things are itchy. They're always squabbling. They nag him endlessly. But at this point, he'd probably miss them if they ever cleared up.
ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION_HEA: Massive sloth skinned zombie with a case of the imps. Carries and throws three imps instead of just one.
ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_HUNTER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}700
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.12

{FLAVOR}Shhhhh ... Hunter Zombie didn't actually kill that sabertooth tiger. He found the skin at a thrift store. Also, he's a vegetarian. Tell no one.
ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_HUNTER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Zombie that can throw snow balls at range to cool down plants until they freeze into blocks.
ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_HUNTER_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}750
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.24
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}snow balls instantly freeze plants and deal 80 damage
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}smashes plants with his club instead of eating, dealing 2 times the normal damage

{FLAVOR}He isn't giving it his 100% today, his cousin Eddie came to the village and they went clubbing all night and then some. It was a pretty wild night. He's still pretty hazy about the whole thing, and he's pretty sure a weasel got involved somewhere? He lost his hide wallet too and he's pretty upset about that as well, so it's probably either Eddie or the weasel, and cousin Eddie is no liar.
Zombie that throws an instant freezing snow ball and smashes plants.
ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_IMP_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.22

{FLAVOR}Yeti Imp recently took up knitting. He started with a scarf, moved on to mittens and eventually knitted an entire bodysuit out of hair he shaved off of Yeti Zombie. He just loves knitting. When those needles are in his hands, he feels a sense of calm he's never felt before.
ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Thrown over most of your defenses, then ambles onward.
ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_TROGLOBITE_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}470
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}each ice block has 600 HP

{FLAVOR}Troglobite has been pushing ice blocks across the tundra day in and day out for as long as he can remember. It's cold and exhausting work, and frankly, he's ready for a vacation. He'd like to go somewhere sunny and warm for a change. He'd like to relax in the sand. He hears Big Wave Beach is nice this time of year.
ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_TROGLOBITE_DESCRIPTION_HEA: Strong zombie that can push blocks of ice across the lawn.
ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_WEASELHOARDER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}releases zombie ice weasels when damaged

{FLAVOR}Weasel Hoarder claims she's the one who wrote the song "Pop! Goes the Weasel." And for eons now, she's been demanding royalties for it. But everyone just ignores her. They know that Weasel Hoarder can't even carry a tune, much less write a catchy ditty about the sound vermin make when hugged a bit too tightly.
ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_WEASELHOARDER_DESCRIPTION_: Zombie hiding in a log with a pack of snow weasels. Weasels are released when her log is shattered.
ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_WEASELHOARDER_VETERAN_DESC:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}900
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.16
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}releases zombie permafrost weasels when damaged and yodels for additional weasel support

{FLAVOR}Weasel Queen has always heard that 'Home is where the heart is', but that can't be right as she's been carrying around that log for who knows how long and hasn't gotten any less crummy. Then, it hit her: whoever made up all that mumbo-jumbo must've gotten the organ mixed up, because she is certain that home is exactly where the good food is. In conclusion? Just let her in already!
Zombie with the dangerous power to yodel.
ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_WEASEL_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Once released, weasels run full speed even over ice floes to nibble your brains.
ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_WEASEL_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION: Weasels hardened by the cold, immune to slowdown effects.
ZOMBIE_IMPPEAR_IMP_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.22

{FLAVOR}Their existence is a mystery. Where do they come from? Why are they in their underpants? Why does Birthdayz Barrel Roller cart them around in gifts? He was featured on X-Files once and they still didn't figure it out.
ZOMBIE_IMPPEAR_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Zombies converted into Imps by Imp Pear become Imp Pear Imps.
ZOMBIE_IMPPEAR_IMP_SUMMONER_ALMANAC_DESC:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}480
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}teleports other zombies 1.5 tiles forward
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}summons Imp Pear Imp and Present Imp
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}immune to magic effects

{FLAVOR}He's a 100% bonafide magician. You can tell, as he lacks the sleeves to hide tricks in. And the shirt, and the pants, and the shoes...
Teleports zombies forward and summons imps using his magic tricks.
ZOMBIE_IMPPEAR_OVERSEER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}8000
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}summons imps and Present Rollers

{FLAVOR}Once a mere skin crawler, he wished to position itself as the new nanny of the imps. And so, through various means, he gained the knowledge to take the form of a big headed Super-Fan Imp, ready to take on a new overseer role, unaware of the one individual who already posseses it...
ZOMBIE_IMPPEAR_OVERSEER_DESCRIPTION_HEAD: Marches on a set place on board. From there it summons various small critters.
ZOMBIE_IMPPEAR_PIANO_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}840
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.145
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}crushes plants with piano
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}causes cowboy zombies to switch lanes

{FLAVOR}He's currently learning the theme song to a popular children's program featuring a purple dinosaur. The Nanny HATES it.
ZOMBIE_IMPPEAR_PIANO_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: His childish piano tunes cause dancing zombies to switch lanes.
ZOMBIE_LEPRACHAUN_DODO_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}490
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.3
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}75% resistant to stun effects

{FLAVOR}The Leprechaun Imp and the dodo go way back. This unlikely friendship is, in fact, a very clever symbiosis. Leprechaun Imp provides the gold, and the dodo eats the gold. It's a simple process, really.
ZOMBIE_LEPRACHAUN_DODO_DESCRIPTION_HEADE: Dodo bird with a Leprechaun Imp rider. The dodo can flap and jump over barricades as well as troublesome plants.
ZOMBIE_LEPRACHAUN_IMP_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.22
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}75% resistant to stun effects

{FLAVOR}There is no convincing him that bathing in gold is unhealthy. One comic book of Zcrooge McDuck was all it took for him to convert his lifestyle.
ZOMBIE_LEPRACHAUN_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Scuddles onto the battlefield with a pot of gold that totally belongs to him.
ZOMBIE_LION_DANCE_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1800
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.14
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}50% resistant to fire damage
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}breathes fire towards nearby plants
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}crushes plants

{FLAVOR}They're still confused on what the year is, Wooly Imp was too busy organizing with the other zombies. He told them to not dress up as camels this year, so they listened. They had to cut out Malcom though, who played the titular role of the camel's hump. Last they heard of him, he had some real choice words on Wooly Imp's planning skills and why he just won't tell them what animal they should dress up as. Nowadays, team isn't like what it used to be, but it's best not to step out of line, lest they end up as a lion with two legs.
ZOMBIE_LION_DANCE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: A duo of zombies that enter your lawn to provide a fiery and crushing performance.
ZOMBIE_LOSTCITY_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}370 (cone) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}No one ever presumes that he’s Dr. Unlivingstone. Just once, though, he wishes that someone would.
ZOMBIE_LOSTCITY_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEADE: His expedition cone makes him twice as tough as normal adventurers.
ZOMBIE_LOSTCITY_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1100 (bucket) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}Buckethead Adventurer’s greatest discovery was that one morning, without warning or reason, there was a bucket on his head.
ZOMBIE_LOSTCITY_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEADE: His rugged bucket provides considerable protection from damage.
ZOMBIE_LOSTCITY_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}2200 (temple) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}Templehead Zombie often has to attend therapeutic sessions with Dr. Zomboss. The constant barrage of clueless adventurer zombies trying to find hidden artifacts inside of him makes him feel violated. You can see his story now on the next episode of "Dr. Zomboss Cares About His Employees."
ZOMBIE_LOSTCITY_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION_HEADE: An entire temple on his head allows for great damage protection.
ZOMBIE_LOSTCITY_BUG_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}350 + Adventurer Zombie cargo
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.4

{FLAVOR}Bug Zombie and Bug make a great team, partly because Bug gives Bug Zombie great mobility, but mostly because they share an intense disinterest in horses.
ZOMBIE_LOSTCITY_BUG_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Bug carries zombie in over ground defenses and lifts him over barriers.
ZOMBIE_LOSTCITY_CRYSTALSKULL_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}250
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}fires a beam in a 4 tiles area, dealing 4000 damage

{FLAVOR}Unlike the more famous crystal skulls, turquoise skulls are totally non-mysterious and common as dirt.
Uses skull to steal sun, then unleashes energy in a destructive beam.
ZOMBIE_LOSTCITY_CRYSTALSKULL_VETERAN_DES:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}700
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.12
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}deals 5 times the normal damage
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}boosts every zombies' speed by 100% and toughness by 43% for 8 seconds after reaching the eighth column

{FLAVOR}Upon being dropped, the Magenta Skull would implode, releasing the thousand tortured sounds from their eternal prison to bring their wrath upon the world once more. But don’t worry: Magenta Skull Zombie passed his ZSATS. We’re in good hands.
Magenta Skull Zombies use their weird magenta skulls to boost all other zombies.
ZOMBIE_LOSTCITY_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}Adventurer Zombie just went looking for a jolly good show, and somehow ended up in the Lost City. "Hmm. Yes. Quite." is all that he would say on the matter.
ZOMBIE_LOSTCITY_EXCAVATOR_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}350
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.3
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}blocks incoming projectiles, but is vulnerable to lobbed shots

{FLAVOR}Excavator Zombie once heard a song about having a hammer. He liked the idea, but decided it was too mainstream for him – so he got a shovel. Now he’s confident that he’s clearly the coolest zombie, the others are just too jealous to admit it.
ZOMBIE_LOSTCITY_EXCAVATOR_DESCRIPTION_HE: Digs up plants and throws them behind him.
ZOMBIE_LOSTCITY_EXPLORER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}600
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.165
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}torch destroys plants on contact
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}cold attacks extinguish torch

{FLAVOR}During one of the most important expeditions, Lost Explorer Zombie found an artifact so peculiar that upon grabbing it, it instantly teleported him to Ancient Egypt. From there on, he took a new identity: "Explorer Zombie." He was lost no more, he knew what he had to do: burn plants for a living.
ZOMBIE_LOSTCITY_EXPLORER_DESCRIPTION_HEA: Carries a torch that can instantly destroy your plants and brighten the night.
ZOMBIE_LOSTCITY_FLAG_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}Flag Adventurer Zombie is always shouting "Tally ho!" as he leads the charge. At least, he's shouting it in his head.
ZOMBIE_LOSTCITY_FLAG_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Marks the arrival of an intrepid "wave" of zombies.
ZOMBIE_LOSTCITY_FLAG_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}350
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.4

{FLAVOR}His previous job as a librarian earned him the skill of walking insanely fast. He doesn’t really know how they correlate, but he isn’t complaining.
Marks the arrival of a massive lost crew of zombies.
ZOMBIE_LOSTCITY_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}3600
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.24
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}crushes plants with torch
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}throws Lost City Imp when damaged

{FLAVOR}Porter Gargantuar dreams of the discovery that will make him powerful and influential. Maybe then the Imps will be the one carrying him around. It's always nice to have dreams.
ZOMBIE_LOSTCITY_IMPPORTER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}350 + 500 (backpack)
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}tent has 700 HP

{FLAVOR}Imp Porter is stronger than he looks. He’s also more charming, smarter and has a better education.
ZOMBIE_LOSTCITY_IMPPORTER_DESCRIPTION_HE: Drops pack on Gold Tile, pack becomes tent from which zombies emerge.
ZOMBIE_LOSTCITY_IMP_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.22

{FLAVOR}Nepotism got Lost City Imp where he is. He’s Bug Zombie’s second cousin thrice removed, but he parlayed that connection into a sweet gig getting carried around in a little box.
ZOMBIE_LOSTCITY_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Gets tossed past most defenses, then explores on foot.
ZOMBIE_LOSTCITY_JANE_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}350
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.25

{FLAVOR}Wealthy beyond reason, the Parasol Zombie lived a life of luxury – when what she craved was a life of adventure. She funded the expedition to the Lost City and set out to see its wonders for herself, never forgetting to bring her trusty parasol. "In case it rains," she explained – but it only came out sounding like "Brains."
ZOMBIE_LOSTCITY_JANE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Parasol provides protection from lobbed projectiles.
ZOMBIE_LOSTCITY_LOSTPILOT_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}350
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.2

{FLAVOR}He faked his pilot's license and figured nobody would notice. But they did.
